headline: Brazilian Real Rises After Central Bank Maintains Interest Rates
summary: The Brazilian real closed 0.68% higher at 5.48 per dollar after the central bank's Copom committee decided to maintain the benchmark interest rate at 13.75% per year.
why: Interest rate decisions are critical for currency valuation, as higher rates generally attract foreign capital seeking better yields, strengthening the local currency.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Maintaining high interest rates supports the currency's carry trade appeal.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The decision to hold rates at a high level relative to other markets increased the attractiveness of the real for investors.
